title: Get paid
summary: Your pay goes straight to your account.

steps.headline: Your pay up front
steps.body: The job shows Job price, Platform fee and You receive.
steps.narration: Before you apply, every job shows the job price, the platform fee, and what you receive.

steps.headline: Client confirms
steps.body: When the client confirms the job is done, your pay is released.
steps.narration: When the client confirms the job is done, your pay is released right away. You do not need to ask for it.

steps.headline: Sent automatically
steps.body: Your pay goes automatically to your linked GCash, Maya or bank account.
steps.narration: It goes automatically to the GCash, Maya or bank account you linked.

steps.headline: Payout account
steps.body: Open Profile, then Payout account, to check or change where pay goes.
steps.narration: To check where your pay goes, open Profile, then Payout account.

steps.headline: Earnings
steps.body: Open Profile, then Earnings, to see your pay.
steps.narration: Open Profile, then Earnings, to see your pay. It is a simple list.

steps.headline: Released to you
steps.body: See what was released to you, and what is on its way.
steps.narration: See what was released to you, what is on its way, and the platform fees. Everything is in one place.

steps.headline: Sent to your account
steps.body: Each payout is listed once it is sent to your account.
steps.narration: Each payout is listed here once it is sent to your account.

steps.headline: Next job
steps.body: Back to the Feed for your next job.
steps.narration: That is it. Head back to the Feed to find your next job.
